kept.spine: A traveller reaches the market at Hochhausen without asking the way.
A stranger new to Hochhausen sees professionals kept for its safety, not chance and neighbours.
In Hochhausen, people can afford to argue about matters other than money.
Hochhausen gets what it needs and moves what it makes.
Complaints in Hochhausen outnumber the ones anyone has settled.
Nothing about Hochhausen runs spare, and that absence is the first thing a careful eye notices.
No practitioner is kept in Hochhausen, no arrangement made, and no expectation of either.
What feeds Hochhausen is grown within reach, safe from a closed road and not from a bad year.
Goods move in and out of Hochhausen, and neither direction draws notice.
The road Hochhausen sits on is also the one it lives by, goods and people passing along it.
This is the size a village of its kind tends to settle at, and Hochhausen has settled there.
One of Hochhausen's ties outweighs the rest, and that weight shows in the choices the town makes because of it.
A careful eye on Hochhausen finds one loose end, the kind that a single institution could tie off.
